general.description: Nicophar is a world of deep waters and high cliffs. Carplanes and boats are the main way to go from a mountain-island to another or to "land" in the leaf-like structure that floats on the Global Ocean. Cetaceans are considered as citizens by the authorities of this water planet.
general.bar: Tourists, merchants and locals are sipping some drinks at the bar, under the curious eyes of all sorts of cetaceans on the other side of the reverse aquarium windows.
